column1: # B888-CC1 (#204): the full 26 in-era race/gender pairs, ONE untouched
# creation each, FacePick (Set Face) open with the in-era Luclin models.
# oracle_remote.sh saves the original eqclient.ini, enables the 26 in-era
# UseLuclin keys for this plan, and restores the original bytes on stop.
# The stock all-FALSE state renders FACE only on the current lane-5 rig.
# Flow: facepick-rows <race> 0 0 <gender> <label> selects the pair and
# stills the open modal with its in-driver arrow probe (rows.tsv), then
# close-creation returns to character select for the next pair. Nothing is
# submitted (page 0 only): no DB rows, no create packets, and the
# driver's create-name arming does not apply.
